evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive issued in the present to erase knowledge of specific named artifacts (fleet, contracts); the command itself is an irrealis demand for a future state-change.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Present-tense imperative demanding erasure of specific concrete knowledge (routes); the command targets a desired non-actual state.
